title.en: Organising process and span of management

hook.en: How many students can one class teacher really look after? How many workers can one supervisor manage? The answer shapes the whole organisation.
hook.kn: ಒಬ್ಬ ತರಗತಿ ಶಿಕ್ಷಕ ಎಷ್ಟು ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳನ್ನು ನೋಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳಬಹುದು? ಒಬ್ಬ ಮೇಲ್ವಿಚಾರಕ ಎಷ್ಟು ಕೆಲಸಗಾರರನ್ನು ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸಬಹುದು? ಈ ಉತ್ತರ ಇಡೀ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ರೂಪ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Explain the steps of the organising process
Explain span of management and its effect on levels

narration.en: How many students can one class teacher really look after? How many workers can one supervisor manage? The answer shapes the whole organisation.
narration.kn: ಒಬ್ಬ ತರಗತಿ ಶಿಕ್ಷಕ ಎಷ್ಟು ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳನ್ನು ನೋಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳಬಹುದು? ಒಬ್ಬ ಮೇಲ್ವಿಚಾರಕ ಎಷ್ಟು ಕೆಲಸಗಾರರನ್ನು ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸಬಹುದು? ಈ ಉತ್ತರ ಇಡೀ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ರೂಪ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: The steps are: identification and division of work; departmentalisation, that is grouping similar jobs; assignment of duties to suitable people; and establishing reporting relationships so that everyone knows from whom to take orders and to whom to report.

narration.en: The steps are: identification and division of work; departmentalisation, that is grouping similar jobs; assignment of duties to suitable people; and establishing reporting relationships so that everyone knows from whom to take orders and to whom to report.
narration.kn: ಹೆಜ್ಜೆಗಳು: ಕೆಲಸದ ಗುರುತಿಸುವಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಭಜನೆ, ವಿಭಾಗೀಕರಣ, ಕರ್ತವ್ಯಗಳ ಹಂಚಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ವರದಿ ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳ ಸ್ಥಾಪನೆ.

title.en: On the board: process and span

narration.en: Watch the board as we build this up step by step.

say.en: The organising process has four steps. Write them one below the other.
Now span of management. With a narrow span of 2, we need many levels: a tall structure.
With a wide span, one manager supervises many people: a flat structure with fewer levels.
One thousand workers with a span of ten need three levels above them: 100, then 10, then 1.

caption.en: Span of management: wider span, fewer levels

narration.en: Change the number of workers and the span of each manager. Watch how many levels of management are needed.

tryThis.en: With 1,000 workers, compare a span of 5 and a span of 20.
Which span gives a tall structure? Which gives a flat one?
Why might a very wide span weaken control?

problem.en: A call centre in Bengaluru has 1,000 agents. Each team leader can handle 10 agents, each manager 10 team leaders, and so on. How many team leaders and managers are needed, and how many levels?

steps.en: So there are 3 levels above the agents: 100 + 10 + 1 = 111 managers in all.

answer.en: 100 team leaders, 10 managers and 1 head: three levels.

narration.en: Let us work through this case together. A call centre in Bengaluru has 1,000 agents. Each team leader can handle 10 agents, each manager 10 team leaders, and so on. How many team leaders and managers are needed, and how many levels?
Team quiz. Each row is a team; discuss quietly and give one answer per team.
narration.kn: ತಂಡ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಸಾಲು ಒಂದು ತಂಡ; ಮೆಲ್ಲನೆ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ ತಂಡಕ್ಕೆ ಒಂದು ಉತ್ತರ ನೀಡಿ.

narration.en: Now some CBSE board pattern questions: assertion–reason and case based.

points.en: Organising: divide work, departmentalise, assign duties, set reporting lines.
points.kn: ಸಂಘಟನೆ: ಕೆಲಸ ವಿಭಜನೆ, ವಿಭಾಗೀಕರಣ, ಕರ್ತವ್ಯ ಹಂಚಿಕೆ, ವರದಿ ಸಂಬಂಧ.

points.en: Span of management is the number of subordinates per superior.
points.kn: ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆಯ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ ಎಂದರೆ ಒಬ್ಬ ಮೇಲಧಿಕಾರಿಗೆ ಇರುವ ಅಧೀನರ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ.

points.en: Narrow span gives a tall structure; wide span gives a flat one.
points.kn: ಕಿರಿದಾದ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ ಎತ್ತರದ ರಚನೆ; ವಿಶಾಲ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ ಚಪ್ಪಟೆ ರಚನೆ.

homework.en: Explain the steps in the process of organising.

narration.en: Recap. Organising: divide work, departmentalise, assign duties, set reporting lines. Span of management is the number of subordinates per superior. Narrow span gives a tall structure; wide span gives a flat one.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಸಂಘಟನೆ: ಕೆಲಸ ವಿಭಜನೆ, ವಿಭಾಗೀಕರಣ, ಕರ್ತವ್ಯ ಹಂಚಿಕೆ, ವರದಿ ಸಂಬಂಧ. ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆಯ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ ಎಂದರೆ ಒಬ್ಬ ಮೇಲಧಿಕಾರಿಗೆ ಇರುವ ಅಧೀನರ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ. ಕಿರಿದಾದ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ ಎತ್ತರದ ರಚನೆ; ವಿಶಾಲ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ ಚಪ್ಪಟೆ ರಚನೆ.
